scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.lint: python3 -m ruff check tests tools && pnpm exec prettier --check package.json .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.smoke: node -e 'if (process.version !== "v24.13.0") { console.error("Expected Node v24.13.0, got " + process.version); process.exit(1); }' && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run hello && python3 -m pytest -q tests/bootstrap/test_environment_smoke.py
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run smoke
